title: Actual tower purity maps and finite comparison words
statement: For a prime $\ell$, finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, schemes $X,Y$, strict coefficient towers and fixed operation, evaluation and adjunction presentations [det-sp-tower-gluing, det-sp-tower-shriek-levels], define the coefficient unit, ordered positive Tate line, twisted pullback source, realized exceptional functor, actual projection/counit transpose and its oriented composite. Define root, tensor, source and target finite evaluation words using normalized site and K-flat comparisons; FiniteLevels is their actual commuting-square predicate. Purity packages the diagonal orientation, natural invertible composite, source membership, both normalized-output assertions, and those finite squares. The definitions are extracted verbatim from det-sp-tower-gamma; no object is chosen from existence.
